title: Vati /api/v1 service in Frappe for the auditor app
scope: Serve the integration/api/openapi.json operations the auditor app uses (cases, case detail, evidence, entities, findings, review state, decisions, evidence requests, taxpayer, management summary) from Frappe with real data, roles and tenant headers, plus the TAX-096 briefing and finding-feedback operations

acceptance.text: A Frappe-hosted /api/v1 router (or whitelisted equivalents with the same contract shapes) backed by Frappe records, the Jube case projection, OpenAleph/yente entities and TAX-086 findings; CSRF/session auth; ADR-003 error codes; contract tests reuse the existing examples

Every auditor-app call has a live implementation that passes the contract checks; officer roles and separation of duties are enforced server-side; no fixture data is returned in live mode and the management summary is computed from real records
Record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a PR

verification: Every auditor-app call has a live implementation that passes the contract checks; officer roles and separation of duties are enforced server-side; no fixture data is returned in live mode and the management summary is computed from real records
